about_the_game:
Fight versus infinite hordes of lizards and italian brainrot animals in post-soviet environment.

Gameplay:

In this survivors-like game you will dive in different post-soviet places which are attacked by the ancient lizard's army as well as hordes of newly awakened italian brainrot animals. Pick your party, slay enemies, upgrade your weapons and characters, slay more enemies much effectively!

Enemies:

Lizards are the most ancient enemies of our ancestors, but they never learn and continue to encroach on our territories to this day, but have you ever heard of a Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala or Bombardiro Crocodilo? Surely you have! These, and many other brainrot animals, united with lizards, have filled the Russian land, it's time to put an end to the expansion of this infection!

Features:

  • Two game modes:

    • Exploration mode with relatively long sessions to explore large cities and finding new playable characters and more powerful upgrades for them

    • Waves mode with short waves and tons of monsters you need to fight for unlocking new weapon parts which will make your weapons stronger or even completely different

  • Party system, you do not need to stay all by yourself, only if you like it

  • Many different characters with unique weapons on all of them, try to combine them rationally to have a balanced party without weaknesses

  • Weapon customization system

  • Character customization system

  • Different types of enemies and intimidating bosses
